name: Hongbaoli Group Corporation, Ltd.
summary: Hongbaoli Group Corporation, Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and markets polyurethane rigid foam polyether, special polyether, and isopropanolamine series of products in China and internationally. It offers monomer polyether; formulated polyol for use in refrigerators, freezers, water heaters, containers, construction panels, and pipelines; and isopropanolamines for use in surfactant, pharmaceutical and pesticide intermediates, metal working fluids, gas treating, industrial and consumer cleaners, cement additive, coating, personal care products, polyurethane, and other applications.
